data.name: Shell_Notice_SaveFailed_Format
data.value: Your settings and locations could not be saved: {0} Noctaxis will try again when something changes.

data.name: Shell_Notice_SettingNotApplied_Format
data.value: A settings change could not be applied: {0}

data.name: Shell_Notice_StateNewerVersion_Format
data.value: Your saved Noctaxis data comes from a newer version of Noctaxis (data version {0}; this version understands up to {1}). To keep it intact, nothing you change in this session will be saved. Use the newer version to keep working with your saved data.
data.comment: {0} is the data version in the file; {1} is the newest data version this build understands.

data.name: Shell_Notice_StateUnrecognised
data.value: Some of your saved Noctaxis settings come from a newer version of Noctaxis and are not recognised here. To keep them intact, nothing you change in this session will be saved. Use the newer version to keep working with your saved data.

data.name: Shell_Status_StateUnavailable_Format
data.value: Your saved Noctaxis data could not be read, so nothing will be saved this session to protect it. Close any other copy of Noctaxis or anything else using {0}, then restart Noctaxis.
data.comment: {0} is the path of the saved-state file.

data.name: Shell_Search_SavedLocations_Placeholder
data.comment: Placeholder and accessible name of the header search field while the Locations page is open.

data.name: Shell_Search_Places_Placeholder
data.comment: Placeholder and accessible name of the header search field while the Planner is open.

data.name: Shell_Search_Settings_Placeholder
data.comment: Placeholder for the header search field on Settings. Settings search is not built yet, so the field is not shown there; see docs/settings.md.

data.name: Shell_Search_Clear_AccessibleName
data.comment: Name of the button that empties the header search field.

data.name: Shell_Instance_Notice_Title
data.comment: Title of the small window shown when this launch of Noctaxis cannot start.

data.name: Shell_Instance_Notice_Close
data.comment: Button that closes the notice window.

data.name: Shell_Instance_AlreadyRunning
data.value: Noctaxis is already running. Switch to its window to continue planning.
data.comment: Shown when Noctaxis is started a second time and its existing window could not be brought forward.

data.name: Shell_Instance_DataFolderInUse_Format
data.comment: {0} is the path of the data folder.

data.name: Shell_Instance_RestartIncomplete
data.value: Noctaxis could not restart because the previous window has not finished closing. When it has closed, start Noctaxis again. Nothing was changed.
data.comment: Shown when a restart waited for the previous instance and it was still running.
